svg.title: Figure C-0-1. The concept phase on one page
svg.desc: The concept phase, top to bottom: WP-C-01 Item and its boundary; WP-C-12 Item and environment models; WP-C-02 ODD and intended functionality; WP-C-08 Driver, HMI and misuse analysis. Four lanes in parallel: Functional safety: WP-C-03 HARA (39 hazardous events → 8 safety goals), then WP-C-04 Functional safety concept (58 functional safety requirements); SOTIF: WP-C-05 SOTIF hazards and acceptance criteria (13 SOTIF hazards), then WP-C-06 Insufficiencies and triggering conditions (24 insufficiencies · 36 triggering conditions), then WP-C-07 Functional modifications (11 functional modifications); Cybersecurity: WP-C-09 TARA (14 threat scenarios), then WP-C-10 Cybersecurity goals and concept (8 cybersecurity goals); AI: WP-C-11 AI system and AI safety requirements (30 AI safety requirements). All lanes feed the hazard log and argument structure (WP-T-01, WP-K-01), then gate G1, then system design (G2). Every work product is draft. Dashed connectors: HARA and TARA: cyber effects rated on the HARA hazards; FSC and cyber goals: cybersecurity goals protect the safety goals; HARA and SOTIF hazards: one hazard log for HARA and SOTIF hazards; FSC and driver analysis: driver monitoring: a misuse measure, no ASIL; driver analysis and AI requirements: driver-monitoring targets are AI requirements; ODD and AI requirements: ODD claimed only where evaluation data covers it; AI requirements and TARA: model files load without a signature; FSC and modifications: FSC transition rule implemented by FM-03.
svg.text: The concept phase on one page
One box per work product, in the order of the concept activities; the number
in a box is the count of its document's table rows.

FSC ↔ driver analysis: driver monitoring: a misuse measure, no ASIL
driver analysis ↔ AI requirements: driver-monitoring targets are AI
ODD ↔ AI requirements: ODD claimed only where evaluation data covers
AI requirements ↔ TARA: model files load without a signature
FSC ↔ modifications: FSC transition rule implemented by FM-03

g.text: Terms: AI artificial intelligence · ASIL Automotive Safety Integrity Level, A
(lowest) to D (highest), from ISO 26262 · FM-nn functional modification
(WP-C-07) · FSC functional safety concept · G0–G6 gate G0…G6 of the project
lifecycle · HARA hazard analysis and risk assessment (ISO 26262-3) · HMI
human-machine interface: display, sounds, cluster · ISO International
Organization for Standardization · ODD operational design domain: where the
system is meant to work · PAS publicly available specification (ISO/PAS 8800 is
the AI safety one) · SAE SAE International (formerly the Society of Automotive
Engineers) · SOTIF safety of the intended functionality (ISO 21448): hazards
with nothing failing · TARA threat analysis and risk assessment (ISO/SAE 21434)
· WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C
concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A
analyses, O operation, K safety case)
